headline: PBOC SHIFTS GOLD FROM LONDON TO HONG KONG — ~20t Bought In July; 20-Month Buying Streak; China Builds New Bullion Hub
snippet: China's People's Bank of China is accelerating the repatriation of its gold reserves from London to Hong Kong, purchasing approximately 20 additional tonnes in July as part of an unbroken 20-month buying streak, Bloomberg reported August 7. The move supports Hong Kong's development as a global gold trading and clearing hub — with new vaults, clearing systems, and delivery infrastructure under construction — and represents a structural floor bid for bullion that operates independently of Western investor sentiment or Federal Reserve policy cycles.

headline: SE ASIAN ENERGY GIANT TAKES 19.7% STAKE IN STANDARD URANIUM — $3M Strategic PP In Athabasca Basin Junior (TSXV: STND)
snippet: Standard Uranium Ltd. (TSXV: STND) announced August 7 it has agreed to a $3 million strategic investment from a well-established Southeast Asian energy conglomerate with extensive global energy interests, with the investor acquiring 39,215,686 units at CAD$0.0765 per unit for approximately 19.7% non-diluted ownership — one of the first instances of Southeast Asian institutional capital taking a direct strategic stake in an early-stage Athabasca Basin uranium junior. The investment signals that the nuclear energy acceleration underway across Southeast Asia to power AI datacenters and grid decarbonization is now driving strategic buyers upstream into the junior exploration tier, not just the production stage.

headline: GOLIATH SUREBET: 8.09 g/t AuEq Over 16m EXPANDS Bonanza Zone 750 Metres SW; Golden Triangle BC (TSX-V: GOT)
snippet: Goliath Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: GOT) reported August 6 that 2026 drill assays have expanded the Surebet Discovery's Bonanza Zone by 750 metres to the southwest and the Golden Gate Zone by 600 metres, with hole GD-26-417 confirming up to 8.09 g/t gold equivalent over 16.00 metres in newly drilled ground. Gold mineralization has now been intersected in all 386 holes drilled at Surebet since the discovery — a 100% hit rate across a system that continues to grow in all directions — and the fully funded 50,000-metre, 7-rig 2026 program is designed to confirm the motherlode source driving the surface gold anomaly.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS DRILLS 28m At 14.27 g/t AU — Down-Dip Extension At 340m Depth; Upper Antino, Suriname (TSXV: FDR)
snippet: Founders Metals Inc. (TSXV: FDR) reported August 6 that hole FR249 at the Upper Antino target in southeastern Suriname returned 28.0 metres at 14.27 g/t gold from 433.0 metres downhole — approximately 340 metres vertically — representing the strongest single high-grade intercept the company has drilled outside the original Froyo core and a 50-metre down-dip extension below the previously reported FR175 hole. The same hole also cut three additional stacked shear zones above the headline interval (18.0m at 1.04 g/t, 24.0m at 0.36 g/t, 6.0m at 1.62 g/t Au), suggesting the system's multi-zone architecture persists at depth across the company's 102,360-hectare Antino Gold District on the Guiana Shield.

headline: PERPETUA HITS NEW GOLD-ANTIMONY ZONE: 16.2 g/t Au Over 6.4m In Idaho — First Yellow Pine Drilling In Nearly A Decade
snippet: Perpetua Resources Corp. (NASDAQ: PPTA) reported August 6 that the first exploratory drilling at its Yellow Pine area in nearly a decade returned 6.4 metres at 16.2 g/t gold and 1.7% antimony near-surface and 21.3 metres at 3.2 g/t gold with 0.9% tungsten at the newly identified Clark Tunnel Fault Zone — all three metals (gold, antimony, tungsten) classified as US critical minerals, materially expanding the strategic significance of Stibnite as the only large-scale, advanced-stage domestic antimony project in the country. Approximately 5,800 metres of a planned 10,000-metre, 4-rig 2026 program have been completed with assays pending on the remaining holes.

headline: TOCVAN DRILLS 215 METRES Of 0.6 g/t AU — New El Mezquite Discovery 1.9km From Pilot Plant; Sonora Mexico (CSE: TOC)
snippet: Tocvan Ventures Corp. (CSE: TOC) announced August 6 a new near-surface gold-silver discovery at its Gran Pilar Project in Sonora, Mexico — hole JES-26-155 returning 215 metres at 0.6 g/t gold from 36.6 metres depth along the previously undrilled El Mezquite trend, with a lower zone grading 70.2 metres at 0.9 g/t gold and high-grade spikes to 16 g/t Au over 1.5 metres. The discovery sits 1,900 metres east of the company's planned pilot production facility along existing road infrastructure, with Tocvan indicating the El Mezquite trend has the potential to meaningfully expand the project's heap-leach amenable oxide resource base ahead of its pilot plant construction timeline.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD REPORTS $769M Q2, RAISES GUIDANCE — Dividend Up 50%, $214M Net Cash; First Post-Orla Results (NYSE: EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (NYSE/TSX: EQX) reported August 5 its first quarterly results following the July 31 closing of the Orla Mining business combination, posting Q2 revenue of $769.8 million and net income of $230.6 million ($0.29 per share), raising consolidated 2026 production guidance to 870,000–920,000 ounces, and hiking the quarterly dividend 50% to $0.0225 per share. The company exited Q2 with pro forma net cash of $214 million and available liquidity of $1.214 billion — a balance sheet transformation that CEO Darren Hall attributed to the combination of $4,300+ gold, a now 12-asset diversified portfolio spanning seven countries, and a clear organic growth path to 1.9 million ounces annually without requiring further acquisitions.

headline: ENERGY FUELS HITS 1.5M LBS U3O8 BY MID-YEAR — Heavy REE Separation Plant Starts; Spot $86.50/Lb; $1B Cash (UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU, TSX: EFR) reported August 5 that Q2 2026 uranium oxide production of 865,000 pounds pushed first-half output to over 1.5 million pounds — already at the low end of the full-year guidance range — while the company simultaneously broke ground on a commercial-scale heavy rare earth separation plant at its White Mesa Mill in Utah, the only conventional uranium mill currently operating in the US. With spot uranium at $86.50/lb and long-term contracts at $97/lb, and nearly $1 billion in working capital after acquiring VAC and Australian Strategic Materials this year, Energy Fuels is executing the most ambitious US critical minerals vertical integration strategy in the sector.

headline: USA RARE EARTH SURGES 6% AHEAD OF SVRE VOTE — $300M Merger Creates Integrated REE-Magnet Chain; Q2 Due Aug 10 (USAR)
snippet: USA Rare Earth Inc. (NASDAQ: USAR) climbed 6% on August 7 as investors positioned ahead of two near-term catalysts: Q2 2026 financial results scheduled for release after market close on August 10, and a special shareholder meeting on August 28 to vote on the proposed merger with SVRE Holdings Ltd. — a deal that would combine USAR's mining and processing operations with SVRE's permanent magnet manufacturing to create the only fully integrated domestic US rare earth-to-magnet supply chain. The merger terms ($300 million cash plus approximately 126.8 million USAR shares, leaving existing shareholders with roughly 65.9% of the enlarged company) were unanimously recommended by the board, with Moelis & Company providing a fairness opinion.

headline: US TUNGSTEN GIANT FOUND IN NEVADA DESERT — 1.78M Tonnes; America's Largest Known Deposit; Plus Lithium; NASA Land Complicates
snippet: 3 Proton Lithium confirmed at its Railroad Valley Minerals Project in Nye County, Nevada what could be the largest known tungsten resource in the United States — approximately 1.78 million tonnes of tungsten alongside world-class quantities of lithium, potash, and boron, with an estimated $3.5 trillion gross in-ground value representing centuries of US supply potential for minerals currently imported primarily from China. The project faces a major permitting complication: NASA maintains a 17-square-mile land withdrawal over part of the site for satellite calibration operations, blocking exploration of a key portion of the deposit and requiring a government reversal the company is actively pursuing — adding timeline uncertainty to what would otherwise be a strategically transformative domestic critical minerals project.
